recipes.description: Agnolotti del Plin are traditional small hand-pinched meat-filled pasta dumplings from Piedmont, Italy, known for their delicate size and rich filling.
instructions: Prepare the pasta dough by combining flour, eggs, olive oil, and a pinch of salt until it forms a smooth, elastic dough. Wrap in plastic and let rest for 30 minutes.
Cook the filling ingredients: sauté finely chopped onion and celery in butter until soft, add ground roasted meat mix (traditionally veal, pork, and sometimes rabbit), cook until browned, then cool.
Mix the cooled meat mixture with grated Parmigiano cheese, nutmeg, salt, and pepper to create the filling.
Roll out the rested pasta dough into thin sheets.
Place small dots of filling about 2 cm apart on one sheet of pasta.
Cover with another sheet of pasta and press gently to seal around each dot.
Pinch between each mound to create small individual parcels called 'plin.'
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the agnolotti for 2-3 minutes or until they float to the surface.
Drain gently and dress with melted butter and chopped sage or a light meat broth as is traditional.
Serve immediately with grated Parmigiano on top.
recipes.name: Agnolotti Del Plin (Piedmontese Pinched Pasta Dumplings)

recipes.description: Agnolotti del Plin is a traditional small pinched pasta from Piedmont, Italy, filled with a flavorful mixture of slow-cooked meats and vegetables, served with a delicate browned butter and sage sauce.
instructions: Prepare the pasta dough by mixing flour and eggs until it forms a smooth, elastic dough. Wrap it in plastic and let it rest for at least 30 minutes.
Roll out the dough thinly on a floured surface or using a pasta machine.
Prepare the filling by finely chopping cooked veal, pork, and vegetables, then mixing them with grated Parmesan, nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
Cut the rolled dough into rectangles, place small amounts of filling in rows, fold over the dough, and pinch between the filling portions to create small agnolotti shapes.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the agnolotti in batches until they float to the surface, approximately 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, prepare a browned butter sauce by gently heating butter with sage leaves until fragrant and slightly golden.
Drain the cooked agnolotti and transfer them to a serving dish, then toss with the browned butter sauce.
Serve immediately with an additional sprinkle of grated Parmesan cheese.
recipes.name: Agnolotti Del Plin (Piedmontese Pinched Pasta)

recipes.description: Anelletti al Forno is a classic Sicilian baked pasta casserole featuring ring-shaped pasta combined with a savory meat and tomato sauce, layered with Mozzarella and Parmesan cheese, then baked to golden perfection.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Cook the anelletti pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain and set aside.
In a large pan, heat olive oil over medium heat and sauté chopped onion and garlic until soft and translucent.
Add ground beef to the pan and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon.
Stir in chopped tomato, tomato paste, salt, pepper, and dried oregano and thyme, then simmer the sauce gently for about 20 minutes until thickened.
In a baking dish, combine the cooked pasta with the meat sauce, mixing well.
Add cubed Mozzarella and grated Parmesan cheese to the pasta mixture, stirring to combine evenly.
Sprinkle additional Parmesan cheese on top of the assembled mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, until the top is golden and bubbly.
Remove from oven and let sit for 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.name: Anelletti Al Forno (Baked Ring Pasta Casserole)

recipes.description: Anelletti al Forno is a traditional Sicilian baked pasta dish featuring ring-shaped pasta baked with a rich meat tomato sauce and melted cheese, offering a comforting and hearty Italian meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Cook the anelletti pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat, then sauté finely chopped onion until translucent.
Add ground beef to the pan and cook until browned.
Pour in tomato sauce and season with salt, pepper, and a pinch of dried oregano. Simmer for about 15 minutes until the sauce thickens.
In a mixing bowl, combine the cooked pasta and meat sauce, mixing thoroughly.
Butter a baking dish and pour half of the pasta mixture into it.
Add slices of Mozzarella evenly over the pasta layer.
Cover with the remaining pasta mixture and sprinkle grated Parmesan cheese on top.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes until the top is golden and bubbly.
Remove from oven, let it rest for a few minutes, then serve hot.
recipes.name: Anelletti Al Forno (Baked Ring Pasta)

recipes.description: Angel hair pasta tossed with sautéed shrimp, garlic, and a light white wine and lemon sauce, garnished with fresh parsley. This quick and elegant dish is perfect for a light dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the angel hair pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
While the pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add minced garlic to the skillet and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add peeled and deveined shrimp to the skillet, season with salt and black pepper, and cook until pink and opaque, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add white wine to the skillet and let it simmer until reduced by half, about 2 minutes.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet with the shrimp.
Toss the pasta and shrimp with lemon juice, chopped parsley, and red pepper flakes, adjusting seasoning with salt and pepper as needed.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
recipes.name: Angel Hair Pasta with Shrimp

recipes.description: Astakos me Makaronia is a traditional Greek dish featuring fresh lobster cooked in a rich tomato and white wine sauce, served over pasta. This seafood pasta combines Mediterranean flavors with tender lobster meat and a balanced tomato sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente, then drain and set aside.
In a large pan, heat olive oil over medium heat and sauté chopped garlic and chopped onion until translucent and fragrant.
Add chopped tomato and tomato paste to the pan, cooking for a few minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.
Pour in white wine and let it simmer until reduced by half.
Add lobster meat pieces to the sauce and cook for 3-4 minutes until heated through and infused with the sauce flavors.
Season the sauce with salt, black pepper, and chopped fresh parsley.
Combine the cooked pasta with the lobster sauce, tossing gently to coat the pasta evenly.
Serve hot, garnished with additional fresh parsley if desired.
recipes.name: Astakos Me Makaronia (Lobster with Pasta)

recipes.description: A simple and flavorful pasta dish combining crispy bacon and tender shimeji mushrooms, finished with garlic and Parmesan cheese for a savory meal.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain, reserving some pasta water.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add sliced bacon to the skillet and cook until crispy and browned, then remove and set aside, leaving the fat in the pan.
Add chopped garlic to the bacon fat and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add shimeji mushrooms to the skillet and cook until tender and slightly golden, about 5 minutes.
Return the cooked bacon to the skillet and stir to combine with mushrooms and garlic.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet, tossing to combine everything well.
If the pasta seems dry, add reserved pasta water a little at a time to loosen the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Sprinkle grated Parmesan over the pasta and toss once more before serving.
recipes.name: Bacon and Shimeji Mushroom Pasta

recipes.description: Baked Feta Pasta is a simple and creamy pasta dish combining roasted tomato and feta cheese, originating from a viral recipe trend. The feta softens in the oven with tomatoes to create a rich, flavorful sauce, mixed with pasta and fresh basil.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsius (400 degrees Fahrenheit).
In a baking dish, place 200 grams of cherry tomato and drizzle with 1 tablespoon of olive oil and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of salt and 1 teaspoon of black pepper.
Place a block of 200 grams of feta cheese in the center of the tomatoes.
Drizzle the feta cheese with 1 tablespoon of olive oil and sprinkle 2 cloves of minced garlic over the entire dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes until the tomatoes burst and the feta is soft and golden on top.
While the feta and tomatoes bake, cook 250 grams of pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain, reserving 125 ml of pasta water.
Remove the baking dish from the oven and use a fork to mash the tomatoes and feta together, adding fresh basil leaves as desired to create a creamy sauce.
Mix the cooked pasta into the baking dish, adding reserved pasta water little by little until the sauce reaches the desired consistency.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional fresh basil if preferred.
recipes.name: Baked Feta Pasta

recipes.description: A hearty and comforting Italian-inspired bean and pasta soup featuring tender white beans and flavorful broth, perfect for a nutritious meal.
instructions: Soak the dry white beans in water for at least 8 hours or overnight to soften.
Drain the soaked beans and rinse under cold water.
In a large pot, heat olive oil over medium heat and add chopped onion, carrot, and celery; sauté until softened.
Add minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Add the soaked beans to the pot and reduce heat; simmer for about 45 minutes or until beans are tender.
Add diced tomato, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper to the soup, stirring well.
Add uncooked pasta to the pot and cook until al dente, about 10-12 minutes.
Adjust seasoning if needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
recipes.name: Bean and Pasta Soup

recipes.description: Beef Ragu with Pasta is a classic Italian meat sauce slowly simmered with tomatoes and herbs, served over pasta for a hearty and comforting meal.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat until shimmering.
Add finely chopped onion, carrot, and celery; sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant.
Increase heat to medium-high; add ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and no longer pink.
Pour in red wine and let it simmer until mostly evaporated.
Stir in crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, beef broth, dried oregano, dried thyme, salt, and pepper.
Lower heat to a gentle simmer, cover partially, and cook for 1.5 to 2 hours, stirring occasionally, until the sauce is thick and beef is tender.
Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
Drain the pasta and mix with a few spoonfuls of the ragu sauce to coat.
Serve pasta topped with generous portions of beef ragu and sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese and chopped fresh parsley.
recipes.name: Beef Ragu with Pasta
